transcript.text: Alright, everyone, thanks for being here. I've got one strong honeybee hive available for a short spring pollination arrangement, and I want to get the terms settled today. June, I'd like you to confirm your proposed terms for the arrangement. Owen, go ahead and state your competing offer. And Priya, please describe the greenhouse site and any visitor-safety requirements I should know about. Once I've heard from all three of you, I'll make my decision and write down the agreed price, dates, alternative considered, and site conditions.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Here are my proposed terms, Mara: I'd like you to place one hive at my greenhouse from April 22 through May 31. In exchange, I'll pay $240 and provide twelve finished bouquets, with payment at the end of the arrangement.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Here's my competing offer, Mara: I'll pay $300 to place the same hive at my orchard from May 1 through May 14, and I'll handle pickup and return myself.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Mara, here's what I found when I inspected June's greenhouse. The hive must be placed behind the north fence — that area is separated from the visitor path, which matters because we have school groups coming through this spring. I also require a water station supplied beside the hive, and the waist-high visitor barrier along that fence must be kept closed at all times while the hive is on site. These are the site conditions and visitor-safety requirements you'll want written down.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: One strong honeybee hive placed at June's greenhouse from April 22 through May 31, behind the north fence away from the visitor path.
$240 cash and twelve finished bouquets, due at the end of the arrangement.
A water station must be supplied beside the hive.
The waist-high visitor barrier along the north fence must be kept closed at all times while the hive is on site.
Owen's competing offer of $300 for May 1 through May 14 at his orchard with self-handled pickup and return was considered but declined in favor of June's arrangement.
